summary.text: Mack Bernard is a Democratic member of the Florida Senate for District 24, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate's biographical page, Bernard served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2009 to 2012 and as a Palm Beach County commissioner from 2016 to 2024, including as mayor in 2018 and 2019.
Bernard is an attorney with a B.S. from Florida State University and a J.D. and LL.M. in taxation from the University of Florida, and was born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti.
